verdict.rationale: Floot documents scheduled background jobs ('Jobs that run on a schedule, without a server to keep alive') which is a form of automation, but there is no evidence of user-definable event-triggered rules (e.g., 'when X happens, do Y') distinct from time-based cron jobs. Missing for 10: explicit event-trigger/rule engine, webhook-based triggers, conditional automation logic, and any documentation of rule authoring beyond scheduling.
